description: This file defines the AssetMaintenance class and related functions for managing asset maintenance tasks, including validation, task assignment, due date calculation, and maintenance log updates within an ERP system.

classes.name: AssetMaintenance
classes.description: A Document class representing asset maintenance records, including validation and synchronization of maintenance tasks.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates asset maintenance tasks, checking date consistency, overdue status, and task assignment.

methods.name: on_update
methods.description: Handles actions to perform when the asset maintenance record is updated, such as assigning tasks and syncing logs.

methods.name: sync_maintenance_tasks
methods.description: Synchronizes maintenance tasks with maintenance logs, updating statuses as needed.
